headline: Cloud accelerates, but a one-time gain swamps net income
summary_short: Revenue rose to $119.8B, up 24.2% y/y, led by Google Cloud (+82% y/y) and Search; operating income grew 30.4% y/y to $40.8B. Net income surged to $112.2B, but the jump was driven almost entirely by a $98.0B other-income swing tied to unrealized gains on equity investments, not core operations.
summary_long: Revenue reached $119.8B (+24.2% y/y, +9.0% q/q), led by Google Services (+15% y/y, incl. Search +$9.1B and YouTube ads +$1.3B) and Google Cloud (+82% y/y, aided by newly-started TPU-system revenue recognition). Operating income grew 30.4% y/y to $40.8B; operating margin slipped 2.1ppt q/q to 34.0% as opex outpaced revenue, including a $1.5B one-time legal charge in G&A. Net income of $112.2B and diluted EPS of $9.11 were inflated by a $98.0B other-income swing, primarily $77.5B of unrealized gains on a non-marketable equity stake plus $21.4B on marketable equities, not from operations. Cash rose to $55.9B and long-term debt to $98.2B after a $20.3B note issuance; equity jumped to $640.5B following a $49.6B capital raise. No share buybacks occurred this quarter.
